description: Source code for the runtime utility functions of the kyaml library, including the FunctionFilter struct and methods for resource scoping, comment copying, and result handling.

classes.name: FunctionFilter
classes.description: A struct that wraps a function to process YAML resources, managing scoping, results, and error handling.

methods.name: GetExit
methods.description: Returns the error from the Run function execution.

methods.name: getFunctionScope
methods.description: Determines the directory scope of the function based on its configuration annotations.

methods.name: scope
methods.description: Partitions resources into scoped and out-of-scope slices based on directory.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Processes a list of YAML nodes, executing the function, and managing comments, results, and scope.

methods.name: setIds
methods.description: Assigns unique IDs to input nodes for tracking.

methods.name: copyCommentsAndSyncOrder
methods.description: Copies comments and synchronizes order from input nodes to output nodes based on IDs.

methods.name: doResults
methods.description: Handles writing function results to a file if configured.
